scenes.narration: Billing moves to the new provider on March first. Two owners are named, and one question about legal terms is still open.

visual.headline: Billing moves in March
visual.sub: One decision, two owners, one open question

scenes.narration: One decision was made. Billing moves to the new provider on March first, so invoices come from one system by spring.

visual.heading: Decided
items: Billing moves to the new provider on March first
So: one invoicing system by spring

scenes.narration: Two actions follow. Lee writes the migration plan by February tenth. Priya gets finance sign-off on the vendor contract by February twentieth.
Two questions are open. Legal has not reviewed the data processing terms, and nobody owns that yet. Dropping the old invoice format was suggested, but it is not decided.

visual.heading: Open questions
items: Legal review of the data processing terms: no owner yet
Drop the old invoice format: suggested, not decided

scenes.narration: To remember: the move is decided, the plan is due February tenth, and legal needs an owner this week.

visual.heading: Remember
visual.text: Legal review needs an owner this week
